scope: Combined accepted module checkpoints after a Validation-only extraction fix; not a single uninterrupted full run
source_verification: Non-documentation source matched the tested archives at the recorded checkpoint; documentation-only differences at that checkpoint are enumerated.
record_scope: Results describe the recorded source checkpoint; subsequent publication-only changes do not constitute a new runtime run.
module_identity: Historical modules are identified by directory; the previous repository namespace is omitted.
